files.tls_client_wrapper.py:
import os, sys, ssl, socket, subprocess
bb, args = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
a, b = socket.socketpair()
p = subprocess.Popen([bb] + args, stdin=a.fileno(), stdout=a.fileno(),
                     stderr=subprocess.PIPE, close_fds=False)
a.close()
ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
ctx.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
ctx.maximum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
ctx.set_ciphers('AES128-SHA256:@SECLEVEL=1')
try:
    tls = ctx.wrap_socket(b, server_hostname='localhost')
    tls.settimeout(4)
    tls.sendall(b'PING\n')
    data = b''
    while b'\n' not in data:
        c = tls.recv(4096)
        if not c: break
        data += c
    os.write(1, b'CLI:' + data)
    tls.close()
except Exception as e:
    os.write(2, ('wrapper: %r\n' % e).encode())
try:
    rc = p.wait(timeout=4)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    p.kill(); rc = 124
os.write(2, p.stderr.read())
sys.exit(rc)
